FFmpeg runtime license notice
================================

This directory contains the FFmpeg executable distributed with Social Media
Asset Collector.

Build: FFmpeg 8.1.2-essentials_build-www.gyan.dev
Source/build provider: https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/
Configuration: the executable reports --enable-gpl --enable-version3.

The executable is distributed under the GNU General Public License, version 3
or later (GPLv3-or-later). The FFmpeg project license notice is available from
the executable with `ffmpeg -L`. The full license text is available at:
https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt

This notice is not legal advice. Future distributions that need LGPL-compatible
licensing must use a separately reviewed LGPL-compatible FFmpeg build.
